positive_terms: Percentage of net revenue made with products and services that are or that contain substances of very high concern
含高度关注物质产品服务的收入比例
Percentage of net revenue made with products and services that are or that contain substances of very high concern。含高度关注物质产品服务的收入比例。按污染风险或事故、财务项目、币种、期间及预期时间区分。收入占比不是污染量，准备金不是已发生修复支出。
